ForceAbility.Name: Sense Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description:
[P]The Force user can sense the Force interacting with the world around him.
[P]The user may spend [FP] to sense all living things within short range (including sentient and non-sentient beings).
[P]The user may spend [FP] to sense the current emotional state of one living target with whom he is engaged.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Upgrade Difficulty
ForceAbility.Description: Ongoing Effect: Commit [FO]. Once per round, when an attack targets the Force user, he upgrades the difficulty of the pool once.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Sense Thoughts
ForceAbility.Description: Effect: Spend [FP]. The Force user senses the current thoughts of one living target with whom he is engaged.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: Sense's ongoing effect may be triggered one additional time per round.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase number of targets affected by power equal to magnitude upgrades purchased.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: When using Sense's ongoing effects, upgrade the pool twice, instead of once.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Upgrade Ability
ForceAbility.Description: Ongoing Effect: Commit [FO]. Once per round, when the Force user makes a combat check, he upgrades the ability of that check once.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Influence Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description:
The character may attempt to guide, shape, and even twist the thoughts and feelings of other.
[P][B]Special Rule ([LI]/[DA] use)[b]: When guiding and shaping thoughts, only [FP] generated from [DA] may be used to generate negative emotions such as rage, fear, and hatred. Only [FP] generated from[LI] may be used to generate positive emotions such as peace, tranquility, and friendliness. Other emotions such as confusion can be created from [FP] generated from either [LI] or [DA].
[P]The character may spend [FP] to stress the mind of one living target he is engaged with, inflicting 1 strain.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase targets affected equal to Magnitude upgrades purchased.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Emotion/Belief
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user may make an [B]opposed Discipline vs. Discipline check[b] combined with an [B]Influence power check[b]. If the user spends [FP] and succeeds on the check, he can force the target to adopt an emotional state or believe something untrue, lasting for 1 round or 5 minutes.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Skills
ForceAbility.Description: When making a Coercion, Charm, Deception, Leadership, or Negotiation check, the Force user may roll an [B]Influence power check[b] as part of his dice pool. He may spend [FP] to gain [SU] or [AD] (user's choice) on the check.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: When stressing the mind of a target, the character inflicts 2 strain.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase duration by number of rounds (or minutes) equal to Duration upgrades purchased.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Move Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description:
The Force user can move small objects via the power of the Force.
[P]The user may spend [FP] to move one object of silhouette 0 that is within short range up to his maximum range. The default maximum range is short range.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase targets affected equal to Magnitude upgrades purchased.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase silhouette able to be targeted equal to Strength upgrades purchased.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Hurl
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user can hurl objects to damage targets by making a [B]ranged combat check[b] combined with a [B]Move power check[b], dealing damage equal to 10 times silhouette.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Pull
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user can pull objects out of secure mountings or out of an opponent's grasp.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Manipulate
ForceAbility.Description: The character can perform fine manipulation of items, allowing him to do whatever he could normally do with his hands via this power at this power's range.

Sources.Source: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

ForceAbility.Name: Foresee Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description:
The Force user can feel the Force flowing around everything, seeing what is and what will be.
[P] The user may spend [FP] to gain vague hints of events to come, up to a day into his own, personal future.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Initiative (Success)
ForceAbility.Description: When making a skill check to determine Initiative, the user may roll a [B] Foresee power check[b] as part of the pool. He may spend [FP] to gain [SU] on the check.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Defense
ForceAbility.Description: Affected targets increase their ranged and melee defense by 2 for the first round of combat.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Initiative (Maneuver)
ForceAbility.Description: When performing a [B]Foresee power check[b] as part of an Initiative check, the user may spend [FP] to allow all affected targets to take one free maneuver before the first round of combat begins.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase the days into the future the user can see equal to Duration upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase targets affected equal to Magnitude upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to pick out specific details equal to Strength upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Enhance Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description:
When making an Athletics check, the Force user may roll an [B] Enhance power check[b] as part of the pool.
[P]The user may spend [FP] to gain [SU] or [AD] (user's choice) on the check.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Coordination
ForceAbility.Description: Enhance can be used with the Coordination skill.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Resilience
ForceAbility.Description: Enhance can be used with the Resilience skill.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Force Leap (Horizontal)
ForceAbility.Description: Take a Force Leap action: Make an [B]Enhanced power check[b]. The user may spend [FP] to jump horizontally to any location in short range.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Piloting - Planetary
ForceAbility.Description: Enhance can be used with the Piloting (Planetary) skill.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Brawl
ForceAbility.Description: Enhance can be used with the Brawl skill.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Force Leap (Vertical)
ForceAbility.Description: When performing a Force Leap, the user can jump vertically in addition to jumping horizontally.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Piloting - Space
ForceAbility.Description: Enhance can be used with the Piloting (Space) skill.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Brawn
ForceAbility.Description: Ongoing Effect: Commit [FO]. The user increases his Brawn characteristic by 1 (to maximum of 6).

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Agility
ForceAbility.Description: Ongoing Effect: Commit [FO]. The user increases his Agility characteristic by 1 (to a maximum of 6).

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Force Leap (Maneuver)
ForceAbility.Description: The user can perform Force Leap as a maneuver instead of an action.

ForceAbility.Name: Battle Meditation Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description:
[P]The Force user directs allies in battle, making them more effective as a coordinated unit.
[P]The use may spend [FP] to add one automatic [SU] to all checks made by a number of engaged friendly targets to up his Presence before the end of his next turn. If the user used any [DA] to generate [FP], reduce each target's Willpower by 1 (to a minimum of 1) until the end of the encounter.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to affect a number of additional targets equal to Presence per rank of Magnitude purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Orders
ForceAbility.Description: When making a [B]Battle Meditation power check[b], the user may make an [B]Easy ([DI]) Leadership check[b] as part of the pool. If the user is able to activate the power and succeeds on the check, he may send simple orders as part of his power.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Planetary Scale
ForceAbility.Description: May suffer 4 strain to change the range of the power and range upgrades to planetary scale.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to add one additional automatic [SU] to affected characters' checks.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: Commit [FO][FO][FO] to sustain the ongoing effects of the power on each affected target while it remains in range.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: If no [DA] were used to generate [FP], choose one skill. While affected by the power, each affected character counts as having the same number of ranks in the chosen skill as the affected character with the most ranks in the skill. If the user used any [DA] to generate [FP], each affected character must make an [B]Easy ([DI]) Discipline check[b] if he wishes to resist obeying orders.

ForceAbility.Name: Bind Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: [P]The Force user restrains an enemy, preventing the target from acting. [P]The user may spend [FP] to immobilize a target within short range until the end of the user's next turn. If the user used any [DA] to generate [FP], the target also suffers 1 wound per [FP] spend on the check (ignoring soak).

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to affect 1 additional target within range per rank of Magnitude purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to disorient the target for a number of rounds equal to Strength upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Strain
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [DA], whenever a target affected by Bind takes an action, that target suffers strain equal to Willpower.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: Commit [FO][FO][FO] to sustain the ongoing effects of the power on each affected target.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Move
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to move the target one range band closer or farther away.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: When the user is making a [B]Bind power check[b], if the check was not already opposed, the user may roll an opposed [B]Discipline vs. Discipline check[b] against one target of the power. If no [DA] were used to generate [FP] and the user succeeds on the check, he may immediately stagger the target until the end of his next turn. If any [DA] were used to generate [FP] and the check succeeds, the target suffers a Critical Injury, adding +10 to the roll per [FP] spent on the check.

ForceAbility.Name: Heal/Harm Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description:
The Force user bolsters his ally with renewed vigor or saps his foe of vital energy.
[P][B]Heal (light side Force user only)[b]: Spend [FP] to heal a number of wounds equal to Intellect from an engaged living creature (including user).
[P][B]Harm[b]: Spend [FP] to inflict a number of wounds equal to Intellect (ignoring soak) on an engaged living target. The user gains 1 Conflict.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to affect 1 additional target within range per rank of Magnitude purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Medicine
ForceAbility.Description:
[B]Heal[b]: Heal additional wounds equal to ranks in Medicine.
[P][B]Harm[b]: Inflict additional wounds equal to ranks in Medicine.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Strain
ForceAbility.Description:
[B]Heal[b]: If no [DA] generated [FP], target heals strain equal to wounds healed.
[P][B]Harm[b]: If any [DA] were used to generated [FP], user heals strain equal to wounds inflicted.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description:
[B]Heal[b]: Spend [FP] to increase wounds healed by 1 per rank of Strength upgrades purchased.
[P][B]Harm[b]: Spend [FP] to increase wounds inflicted by 1 per rank of Strength upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Status
ForceAbility.Description:
[B]Heal[b]: Spend [FP] to remove one status effect from target.
[P][B]Harm[b]: The user may spend [FP] to heal wounds equal to wounds inflicted on target. Healed character gains 1 Conflict.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Critical
ForceAbility.Description:
[B]Heal[b]: May make a [B]Heal power check[b] combined with a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Medicine check[b]. If the check succeeds, one target who heals wounds also heal one Critical Injury.
[P][B]Harm[b]: May make a [B]Harm power check[b] combined with a [B]opposed Medicine vs. Resilience check[b]. If check succeeds, one target who suffers wounds also suffers one Critical Injury (adding +10 to the roll per [AD][AD]).

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description:
[B]Heal[b]: Once per session, spend [FP][FP][FP][FP] to restore 1 target who died after the end of user's last turn to life.
[P][B]Harm[b]: Once per session, when this power kills a target, may restore one engaged character who died this encounter to life. Each character gains 7 Conflict.

ForceAbility.Name: Misdirect Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description:
The Force user creates illusions to fool those around him.
[P]The user may spend [FP] to make a target at up to short range unable to perceive a chosen person or object of silhouette 1 or smaller. Until the beginning of the user's next turn, the target cannot see or sense the hidden person or object.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: Commit [FO][FO] to sustain this power while the beguiled target remains in range.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to increase the silhouette of the object obscured or illusion created by 1 per Strength upgrade purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Appearance
ForceAbility.Description: The user may alter the perceived appearance of the chosen person or object instead of hiding it.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to affect additional targets equal to Presence per rank of Magnitude purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Illusion
ForceAbility.Description: May use this power to force the target to perceive a single illusory person of object.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Combat
ForceAbility.Description: Commit one or more [FO]. Add [TH] per [FO] to all combat checks targeting Force user.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to obscure additional objects or create illusions equal to Cunning plus Deception.

ForceAbility.Name: Protect/Unleash Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description:
The Force user guides the flow of energy, protecting himself and others or unleashing blasts of power upon his foes.
[P][B]Protect[b]: The user makes a [B]Protect power check[b] and rolls an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Discipline check[b] as part of the pool. Spend [FP][FP] to reduce damage from an energy-based weapon that hits himself or an engaged character by amount equal to Willpower plus 1 per [SU]. Dark Side Force users may only protect themselves.
[P][B]Unleash[b]: The user makes an [B]Unleash power check[b] as ranged attack and rolls an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Discipline check[b] for difficulty. If check succeeds and spend [FP][FP], the attack hits. It has a range of short, a base damage equal to Willpower, and a critical rating of 4. The user gains 1 Conflict.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to affect 1 additional target within range per rank of Magnitude purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to decrease damage or add damage equal to ranks of Strength purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Defense/Strain
ForceAbility.Description:
[B]Protect[b]: Spend [AD] to gain defense equal to [AD] spent.
[P][B]Unleash[b]: Spend [AD] to inflict 1 strain on target.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: All Attacks/Ensnare
ForceAbility.Description:
[B]Protect[b]: Spend [FP] to allow power to protect against all types of attack.
[P][B]Unleash[b]: Spend [FP] to give the attack Ensnare 2.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description:
[B]Protect[b]: If no [DA] generated [FP] the power reduces damage of all attacks hitting the target.
[P][B]Unleash[b]: Spend [FP] to give the attack Burn 2.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Incidental/Maneuver
ForceAbility.Description:
[B]Protect[b]: Light side Force users may spend 1 Destiny Point to use Protect as an out-of-turn incidental once per session.
[P][B]Unleash[b]: Dark side Force users may spend 1 Destiny Point to use Unleash as a maneuver once per session.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description:
[B]Protect[b]: Light side Force users may spend [FP][FP] to reflect attacks they reduce to 0 damage, dealing damage equal to initial attack to attacker.
[P][B]Unleash[b]: Dark side Force users may spend [FP] to reduce critical rating of attacks to 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Seek Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description:
The Force user allows the will of the Force to lead the way to something lost or forgotten.
[P]The user may spend [FP][FP] to gain insight into the general location or direction of a person or object that he knows about, regardless of current distance.
[P]The user may spend [FP] and succeed at an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Vigilance check[b] (or [B]opposed Vigilance vs. Discipline check[b]) to see through illusions.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to gain one additional detail per Magnitude upgrade purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Skills
ForceAbility.Description: Ongoing effect: Commit [FO]. Upgrade the ability of Vigilance and Perception checks once.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to eliminate 1 Force-based illusion per Strength upgrade purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Target
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to track one additional target.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: Commit [FO] to continue tracking target even when it moves.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Pierce
ForceAbility.Description: Ongoing effect: Commit [FO][FO][FO]. The user's attacks gain Pierce with rating equal to Cunning plus ranks in Perception.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Make [B]Seek power check[b] and spend [FP][FP][FP] to add [TR] to combat checks against one target for remainder of encounter.

ForceAbility.Name: Warde's Foresight Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: [P]The Force user can feel the Force flowing around another specific individual to gain insight into what that person might do. The user may spend [FP] to gain hints about what another individual within short range is likely to do in the near future.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: [P]Spend [FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: [P]Spend [FP][FP] to add [BO] equal to Strength upgrades purchased to user's next check against the target.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: [P]Spend [FP][FP] to have the bonuses the power grants apply to all checks for rounds equal to Duration upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: [P]When performing a Warde’s Foresight power check as part of an Initiative check, spend [FP] to add [SU] or [AD] to ally's first check this encounter.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Successes
ForceAbility.Description: [P]When making a skill check to determine Initiative, the Force user may roll a Warde's Foresight power check as part of the pool. He may spend [FP] to add automatic [SU] on his first check this encounter.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Maneuver
ForceAbility.Description: [P]Once per encounter, use the basic power as a maneuver.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Initiative
ForceAbility.Description: [P]When performing a Warde’s Foresight power check as part of an Initiative check, spend [FP] to add [AD] on user’s first check this encounter.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Ally Initiative
ForceAbility.Description: [P]When performing a Warde’s Foresight power check as part of an Initiative check, if the user did not use [DA] to generate [FP] each ally adds automatic [SU] to the results of his Initiative check. If the user used [DA] to generate [FP] the user may immediately perform an action before the encounter begins, but each enemy in the encounter adds automatic [SU] to the results of his Initiative check.

ForceAbility.Name: Suppress Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: [P]The Force user can dampen the effect of incoming force powers, dramatically diminishing their effects on himself and his allies. [P]The user may spend [FP] to add automatic [FA] to force power checks made against him or any ally within short range until the end of his next turn.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: [P]Spend [FP] to add additional [FA] equal to Strength upgrades purchased to hostile Force power checks.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: [P]Ongoing effect: Commit [FO] to sustain ongoing effects of the power on each affected target within range.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Commit
ForceAbility.Description: [P]Commit one or more [FO]. When an opponent targets the user with a Force power, after the opponent generates [FP], reduce the total [FP] generated by 1 per [FO] committed, to a minimum of 0.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Destiny
ForceAbility.Description: [P]Spend 1 Destiny Point to use Suppress as an out of turn incidental once per session.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Strain
ForceAbility.Description: [P]Whenever a Force user targets a character affected by Suppress with a hostile Force power, if that opponent used [DA] to generate [FP] on the check, he suffers strain equal to the user's ranks in Discipline.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: [P]The user may make a Suppress power check along with an opposed Discipline vs. Discipline check targeting another Force user within short range. If the user spends [FP][FP] and succeeds on the check, the target Force user immediately uncommits all [FO] and ends all ongoing effects of Force powers and Force talents that required committed [FO].

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: [P]Spend [FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Farsight Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user expands normal visual senses through a connection to the Force. [BR]The user may spend [FP] to ignore the effects of darkness or blindness and see normally at up to medium range for the remainder of the round (or for one minute). This allows the user to view everything most sentients could normally be able to see on a well lit day.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Microscopic Details
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to see microscopic details of a single object within engaged range.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Transparent
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to see through a single object at medium range as though it were transparent.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Fine Details
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to make out fine details on a single object within medium range.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase duration by number of rounds for minutes equal to Duration upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by one range band equal to Range upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Vigilance
ForceAbility.Description: When making a Vigilance or Perception check, make a Farsight power check as part of the pool and spend [FP] to gain [SU] or [AD] on the check.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Perception
ForceAbility.Description: This power gains the ongoing effect: Commit [FO] after successfully activating the Farsight power to increase ranks in Perception by 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Panoramic Vision
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to see in every direction simultaneously, noticing and observing things in a full 360 degree arc.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP]. The user now can see as though from a spot within close range (planetary scale) of the user's body.

ForceAbility.Name: Manipulate Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user shapes machine components on a molecular level, allowing him to mend damaged mechanical systems. [BR]The Force user may spend [FP] to cause one vehicle or starship he is engaged with to recover one system strain. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Item Damage
ForceAbility.Description: Ongoing effect: Commit [FO] One damaged weapon or item counts as being undamaged.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Increase System Strain
ForceAbility.Description: Ongoing effect: Commit [FO] Increase the system strain threshold of 1 vehicle or starship at engaged range by 3 per [FO] committed.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Mechanics
ForceAbility.Description: When making a Mechanics skill check, the user may roll a Manipulate power check as part of the pool and may spend [FP] to gain [SU] or [AD] (user's choice) on the check.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Heal Droid
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to heal a number of wounds equal to his Intellect in an engaged droid.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Inflict Strain
ForceAbility.Description: When performing a combat check against a droid, ship, vehicle or other mechanical construct within engaged ranged, the user may spend [FP] to inflict 1 additional strain or system strain on the target.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Increase Hull Trauma
ForceAbility.Description: Ongoing effect: Commit [FO]. Increase the hull trauma threshold of 1 vehicle or starship at engaged range by 3 per [FO] committed.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Upgrade Computers and Mechanics
ForceAbility.Description: Ongoing effect: Commit [FO]. Upgrade the ability of Computers and Mechanics check once.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: When using this power spend [FP] to cause targets to recover 1 additional strain or system strain or heal 1 additional wound for every Strength upgrade purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase the power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: When performing Manipulate power check as part of a Mechanics skill check, the user may spend [FP][FP] to gain [TR] on the check.

ForceAbility.Name: Imbue Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user lends strength to allies, making them more potent, resourceful, or resilient for a time. [P]The user may spend [FP][FP] to increase one of another engaged character's characteristics by 1 (to a maximum of 6) until the end of the Force user's next turn. [P]This can only be used once per character per encounter. If the user uses [DA] to generate [FP], the target increases a second characteristic by 1 (to a maximum of 6) until the end of the user's next turn, but both the Force user and target suffer 3 strain.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: If no [DA] were used to generate [FP], decrease all Critical Injuries suffered and inflicted by the target by 10 per Strength upgrade purchased. If no [LI] were used to generate [FP], increase all Critical Injuries suffered and inflicted by 10 per Strength upgrade purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Skill Ranks
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to allow the target to count as having ranks in a skill equal to user's ranks in the skill.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Increase characteristics boosted by this power by 2 (to a maximum of 7) instead of 1 (to a maximum of 6).

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: Commit [FO][FO] to sustain the effects of this power as long as the target remains in range.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: Commit [FO] to sustain the effects of this power as long as the target remains in range.

ForceAbility.Name: Ebb/Flow Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user's action empower himself or sap strength from his foes. [P][B]Ebb:[b] When the Force user makes a skill check, he may roll an [B]Ebb power check[b] as part of the roll. The user may spend [FP] to suffer 1 strain, then inflict 1 strain on all other engaged characters. The Force user may not activate this multiple times. [P][B]Flow:[b] When the Force user makes a skill check, he may roll an [B]Flow power check[b] as part of the roll. The user may spend [FP] to heal 1 strain. The Force user may not activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to exclude number of targets equal to Magnitude upgrades purchased from being affected.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to affect all other characters at short range.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength: Strain
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user may spend [FP] to increase the strain healed or inflicted by 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength: Threat/Advantage
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user may spend [FP] to increase the [TH] or [AD] added by 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength: Failure/Success
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user may spend [FP] to increase the [FA] or [SU] added by 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Question
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP][FP] once per encounter to ask the GM a single "yes or no" question.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Threat/Advantage
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Ebb:[b] When making a [B]combined Ebb power check[b], may spend [FP] to add [TH] to any checks made by engaged opponents until the end of next turn. [P][B]Flow:[b] When making a [B]combined Flow power check[b], may spend [FP] to add [AD] to any checks using the same skill until the end of next turn.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Failure/Success
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Ebb:[b] When making a [B]combined Ebb power check[b], may spend [FP] to add [FA] to any checks made by engaged opponents until the end of next turn. [P][B]Flow:[b] When making a [B]combined Flow power check[b], may spend [FP] to add [SU] to any checks using the same skill until the end of next turn.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Skill Checks
ForceAbility.Description: Commit [FO] until the end of the current encounter. For the remainder of the current encounter, add [FO] to all skill checks. Each [LI] and [DA] adds either [SU] or [AD] to the check; each [DA] causes the user to suffer 1 strain and gain 1 Conflict.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description:
[B]Ebb:[b] Once per session, if a target suffered at least 5 strain from this power, add [DE] to the target's next check.
[P][B]Flow:[b] Once per session, if the user healed at least 5 strain from this power, add [TR] to user's next check.

ForceAbility.Name: Conjure Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user calls forth a spectral object to their hand, which lasts for a short time. [P]The user may spend [FP] to create a facsimile of a Brawl or Melee weapon anywhere within engaged range. At the end of the user's next turn, this item dissipates. At the GM's discretion, the user can instead conjure a simple tool and other useful low-tech item with an encumbrance no greater than 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: Commit [FO] to sustain 1 conjuration per Duration upgrade purchased while it remains at medium range.

ForceAbility.Name: Number
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to create additional, identical conjurations equal to ranks in Number upgrade purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase the maximum encumbrance of the facsimile that can be conjured by 2 per Magnitude upgrade purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Defense Qualities
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to add 1 of the following weapon qualities to the conjuration: Defensive 1, Deflection 1, Stun 4.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Offense Qualities
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to add 1 of the following weapon qualities to the conjuration: Burn 3, Pierce 3, Vicious 3.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase the range at which the facsimile can be conjured and sustained by 1 (to a maximum of extreme).

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP][FP] to summon the facsimile of a creature of silhouette 1 or smaller instead of an object. This creature is bound to the user's will, and mindlessly follows that character's commands until the end of the Force user's next turn. If the user has the corpse of the creature being conjured to imbue with false life, this facsimile lasts until the end of the encounter instead, but the user gains 7 conflict for doing so.

ForceAbility.Name: Alter Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user can tap into the Living Force of their surroundings, manipulating the nearby environs. [P]The Force user may spend [FP] to make all terrain currently within short range difficult terrain until the end of their next turn. [P]The Force user may spend [FP] to make all terrain currently within short range normal terrain until the end of their next turn.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Survival
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] and make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Survival check[b] to instantly discover food, water, or other critical supplies within extreme range.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Concealment
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user may spend [FP] to give all characters within short range of the user concealment.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Animal Senses
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to share the senses of animals within range of this power, adding [BO] to Perception and Vigilance checks, and gaining other benefits.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Firm Terrain
ForceAbility.Description: The power can affect firm terrain, such as packed earth, stone, or ice.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: Commit [FO] after successfully activating the power to sustain its effects while the user remains within range of the affected area.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to allow a number of targets equal to the number of Strength upgrades to ignore this power's effects.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Impassible Terrain
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to make a small patch of terrain within the affected area impassible.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Corrosive Atmosphere
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to create a corrosive atmosphere in a small area within the effected area.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Upgrade Difficulty
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to upgrade to difficulty of all checks made by opponents while in the power's area of effect once.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: When the user activates this power without spending [FP] generated from [DA] results, add [LI] to all other Force power checks made within this power's area of effect. [P]When the user activates this power without spending [FP] generated from [LI] results, add [DA] to all other Force power checks made within this power's area of effect.

ForceAbility.Name: Endure Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: When the character suffers a Critical Injury with a severity rating no greater than [B]Easy ([DI])[b], the character may activate Endure as an out-of-turn incidental and commit [FO] to temporarily ignore the effects of that injury. The character does not apply results from the Critical Injury or add +10 to further rolls on the Critical Injury Result table while [FO] remains committed. When this ongoing effect ends, the character suffers all effects of the Critical Injury (unless it has been treated).

ForceAbility.Name: Strength - Increase Severity
ForceAbility.Description: Increase the severity of Critical Injury that can be affected by one per Strength upgrade purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Control - Additional Injuries
ForceAbility.Description: The character can commit one additional [FO] to temporarily ignore one additional Critical Injury per Control upgrade purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: As an incidental, the character can activate Endure to temporarily ignore a Critical Injury the character is already suffering, and which is of a severity that Endure could affect normally.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: The character can use Endure to affect allies at short range. The ongoing effect ends if the distance between the characters increases beyond short for any reason.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength - Ignore Death
ForceAbility.Description: The character can use Endure to temporarily ignore a Critical Injury result of Dead.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: The character can use Endure to affect allies within medium range. The ongoing effect ends if the distance between the characters increases beyond medium for any reason.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: When activating Endure, the character may make an Endure power check, making a Discipline check with a difficulty equal to the severity of the Critical Injury and adding [FO] up to the character's Force rating. If the character succeeds on the check and generates [FP] equal to the Severity of the Critical Injury, the Critical Injury is not suffered.

ForceAbility.Name: Jerserra's Influence Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: The Force use can project terrifying visions onto foes, forcing them to face their greatest fears. [P]The user may spend [FP] to target one character within short range. That character must immediately make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) fear check[b] as an out of turn incidental.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Strain
ForceAbility.Description: If target suffers strain as a result of Jerserra's Influence, the Force user recovers an equal amount of strain.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Fear
ForceAbility.Description: When making a fear check, the Force user can roll a [B]Jerserra's Influence power check[b] as part of the pool. The user may spend [FP] to gain [SU] or [AD] (user's choice) on the check.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Willpower
ForceAbility.Description: Ongoing effect. Commit [FO]. The user increases his Willpower characteristic by 1 (to a maximum of 6).

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase the number of targets affected by a number equal to Magnitude upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user may target one character within short range and make an [B]opposed Discipline vs. Discipline check[b] combined with a [B]Jerserra's Influence power check[b]. If the user spends [FP] and succeeds on the check, he may commit [FO] and force the target to also commit [FO]. Both dice remain committed until the Force user uncommits that [FO] or the encounter ends.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session, after a target fails a fear check caused by this power, the Force user may have the target perform one action as an out of turn incidental. The Force user gains 3 Conflict.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase the power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user may spend [FP] to increase the difficulty of the fear check by a number of times equal to Strength upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Strain
ForceAbility.Description: If target suffers strain as a result of Terror, the Force user recovers an equal amount of strain.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery: Action
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session, after a target fails a fear check caused by this power, the Force user may have the target perform one action as an out of turn incidental. The Force user gains 3 conflict.

ForceAbility.Name: Burst of Speed Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description:
The Force user increases their speed to maintain sprinting speeds for a brief time.
[P] The Force user may spend [FP] to increase their speed, allowing them to take the Move maneuver as an incidental once per round. This does not count against the number of manuevers a character may take per turn.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: Commit [FO] after successfully activating the power to sustain its effects.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Perceive
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase your current and max Defense by 1 while this power remains active as the world begins to move in slow motion around you.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Surge
ForceAbility.Description: Once per round while this power is active, when the Force user makes a combat check or a Coordination check, they may take 1 strain as an incidental to add [BO] to the check. The user may take strain to add [BO] in this way up to half their Force Rating, rounded up.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: Redirection may now be used on Brawl or Melee combat checks, though the range of this is always engaged with you.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description:
Commit [FO][FO][FO] instead of [FO] when activating this power to accelerate faster than any mortal can run. You are now considered a vehicle when it comes to speed and collisions. Your max speed is your Force Rating, up to 6 maximum. Move maneuvers are considered to be Accelerating / Decelerating for you, and you may use the Punch It maneuver as well but you suffer the strain instead.
[P] If you collide (minor or major collision is up to GM) with a vehicle, both you and the vehicle take a Critical Injury / Hit respectively unless the GM decides the vehicle is too big to be damaged in this way. Your defense zone is treated as your Defense divided by 2, rounded up.
[P]If you hit a personal scale target while this is active, you are treated as a vehicle, but you instead make the check with Coordination or Athletics and suffer wounds equal to your Speed upon hitting a target successfully rather than strain.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Evasion
ForceAbility.Description: You are immune to being Immobilized while this power is active.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Wallcrawler
ForceAbility.Description: While under the effect of Burst of Speed, you can move along walls and water normally.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: React
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter, by spending a Destiny point, you may activate Burst of Speed as an out-of-turn incidental and may take the Move maneuver immediately.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Focus
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to allow you to take any maneuver as an incidental once per round instead of only the Move maneuver.

ForceAbility.Name: Force Body Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description:
The Force user pushes their body's endurance, sacrificing their health and well-being in order to sustain their connection to the Force.
[P] The Force user may activate this power by committing one [FO]. While active, you may take two Wounds in order to generate one [FP] of your choice. You may do this whenever you roll [FO].

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: You may take an additional two wounds equal to your Strength upgrades purchased when rolling [FO] to generate another [FP] of your choice.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Balance
ForceAbility.Description: When you take Wounds to generate [FP] of your choice, you may instead only take one Wound per [FP] generated.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Deflection
ForceAbility.Description: While Force Body is active, you may use the Reflect talent, even when you are not wielding a lightsaber. If you do not have the Reflect talent, you are considered to have one rank in it while Force Body is active.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session, when you activate Force Body, you may suffer a number of Wounds up to twice your Force Rating. For every two wounds suffered, increase your Force Rating for the encounter by one.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Endure
ForceAbility.Description: When the character is incapacitated by going over their Strain or Wound Threshold, they may choose to spend [FP][FP][FP] to stay conscious. On a success, they still suffer the wounds, but are conscious until the end of their next turn. For every additional turn they stay conscious, one additional force point is required to stay conscious. This resets upon being healed above your Wound Threshold.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: The character can use Force Body to affect allies at short range whenever they roll [FO].

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by a number of range bands equal to Range upgrades purchased.

ForceAbility.Name: Choked Breath
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to create a corrosive atmosphere at a single point within the power’s area of effect and any space engaged with it. The rating of the corrosive atmosphere is equal to the user’s current Force rating. This lasts for the duration of the power. The user may activate this multiple times, choosing a new patch of terrain to effect each time.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: The power gains the ongoing effect: Commit a [FO] after successfully activating the basic power to sustain its effects as long as the user remains in the area affected.

ForceAbility.Name: Earth and Sky
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to activate both effects from the basic power simultaneously. If an upgrade from this ability would apply to one of the effects, it applies to both instead. The user may not activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Far Nexus
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to choose a character within medium range of the user to become the originator of the effect, as if they were the user. The chosen character must both be touching the same uninterrupted patch of ground, but upgrades may be activated normally. The user may not activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Firm Earth, Dark Sky
ForceAbility.Description: The power can affect firm natural terrain, such as packed earth, stone, or ice. Concealment granted by this power adds [BO][BO] or [SE][SE] to appropriate checks.

ForceAbility.Name: Forbidden Path
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to make a single point of terrain within the affected area, and all terrain engaged with it, impassable. The nature of this impassable terrain is up to the user; it could be a jagged rock face, a quicksand pit, or a mass of thorn and vine. This lasts for the duration of the power. The user may activate this multiple times, choosing a new patch of terrain to affect each time.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: When the user activates this power without spending [FP] generated from [DA] results, add a [LI] to all other Force power checks made within this power's area of effect for the duration of the power. [P]When the user activates this power without spending [FP] generated from [LI] results, add a [DA] to all other Force power checks made within this power's area of effect for the duration of the power.

ForceAbility.Name: Oppressive Force
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user may spend [FP][FP] to ugprade the difficulty of all checks made by opponents while in the power's area of effect once. This lasts for the duration of the power. This may not be activated multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to increase the range of the affected area to medium range. The user may not activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When activating the Range upgrade, the Force User may instead extend the range of the effect to long range.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] after successfully activating the basic power to immediately perform a free Move maneuver as an incidental. This Move maneuver may be in addition to any other maneuvers performed this turn and can allow the character to perform three maneuvers in a turn.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to exclude characters equal to current Force Rating. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When activating the Strength upgrade, instead exclude a number of characters equal to twice the character’s Force Rating from the effects of the power.

ForceAbility.Name: Trailing Nexus
ForceAbility.Description: The power gains the ongoing effect: Commit [FO] after successfully activating the basic power to have the effect follow the Force User or other originator of the effect while they are in an appropriate environment.

ForceAbility.Name: Rally / Rout
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter when using Battle Meditation, the user may make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Leadership check[b] as part of the pool: [P][B]Unify:[b] On success and power activation, each affected ally recovers strain equal to Presence, minus 1 per [DA] the user spends to generate [FP]. Spend [TR] to increase the user’s allied Force Strength by one during the next Mass Combat check made before the end of the encounter. [P][B]Isolate:[b] On success and power activation, all affected minions groups remove half their members, rounding the remainder up. Spend [TR] to decrease the adversary’s Force Rating by one during the next Mass Combat check made before the end of the encounter.

ForceAbility.Name: Communion / Dissension
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Unify[b]: Affected allies may mentally communicate normally with one another for the duration of the power, and may offer assistance to one another regardless of distance. [P][B]Isolate[b]: Affected foes may not receive [BO] granted by [AD] spends, nor may they offer or receive assistance.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: Commit [FO][FO][FO] to sustain the effects of the power on affected targets while they remain in range.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: Commit [FO][FO] to sustain the effects of the power on affected targets while they remain in range instead of [FO][FO][FO].

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase the number of targets affected by an amount equal to the User's Presence multiplied by the number of Magnitude upgrades purchased. The user may activate this multiple times, increasing the number of targets by this number each time.

ForceAbility.Name: Mass Combat
ForceAbility.Description: The user may add [FO] no greater than Force rating to Mass Combat checks. Spend [FP][FP][FP] to add [SU] to the results. This may be activated multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Unify[b]: Once per session while this power is active, when an affected ally makes a Force Power check or a combined Force check, the user and any number of affected allies may suffer 2 strain and commit [FO]. For each that does, the ally adds an additional [FO] to the check. Afterwards, the Battle Meditation power ends. [P][B]Isolate[b]: Once per session while the power is active, when an affected foe makes a check, the user may add [DE] to that check. Afterwards, the Battle Meditation power ends.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by 1 range band, to maximum of extreme range. This may be activated multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Skill Shared / Skill Taken
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Unify[b]: If no [DA] were used to generate [FP], choose one skill. While affected by the power, each affected character counts as having the same number of ranks in the chosen skill as the affected character with the most ranks in the skill. [P][B]Isolate[b]: If no [LI] were used to generate [FP], choose one skill. All affected foes temporarily reduce their ranks in that skill by half, rounded down (to a minimum of 1). The user temporarily increases their ranks in that skill by 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Unify[b]: Spend [FP] to add [SU] instead of [AD]. This may not be activated multiple times. [P][B]Isolate[b]: Spend [FP] to add [FA] instead of [TH]. This may not be activated multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Unify[b]: Spend [FP][FP] to add an additional [SU]. [P][B]Isolate[b]: Spend [FP][FP] to add an additional [FA].

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to change the range of the power and range upgrade to planetary scale. The user suffers 3 stran at the beginning of each of their turns while Battle Meditation is active using this upgrade.

ForceAbility.Name: Bind: Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to immobilize a target for or simple, inert object with a silhouette of 1 or less within short range until the end of the user's next turn. If the user used a [DA] to generate [FP], the target suffers 1 wound per [FP] spend on the check (ignoring soak). Any character or object immobilized in this way cannot be moved unless an [B]opposed check vs the character's Discipline[b].

ForceAbility.Name: Bound Aggression
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter after a foe makes a successful attack but before it deals damage, the user may suffer 3 strain to use Bind on the attacker as an out-of-turn incidental. Spend additional [FP] to add that many [FA] to the result of the check.

ForceAbility.Name: Confounding Bindings
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to add [SE][SE] to checks made by all affected foes for the duration of this power.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: The power gains the ongoing effect: Commit [FO][FO][FO] after successfully activating the basic power. If a target was immobilized or staggered by this power, they remain immobilized or staggered as long as three Force dice remain committed and the target stays within range. If a target moves beyond the range of the power, the effects end for that target, but not for any other targets of the power. The user may not activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Force Tractor
ForceAbility.Description: After successfully activating the basic power targeting a starship or vehicle, treat it as if it were affected by the Tractor quality for the duration of the power, except that checks to escape the tractor are opposed by the user's Discipline. If [DA] was used to generate [FP], the target suffers 1 system strain per [FP] generated on the check. [P]Additionally, after immobilizing a ship or character, the user may spend [FP] to move the affected targets one range band, and may choose a different direction for each target.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to affect 1 additional target within range. The user may activate this multiple times, increasing the number of targets by this number each time.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When the user activates the Magnitude upgrade, they instead affect additional targets equal to half the user's Willpower, rounded up.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: When using Bind, if otherwise unopposed, may make an [B]Opposed Discipline vs. Resilience check[b] as a part of the pool against a target. On success, if no [DA] were used to generate [FP], immediately stagger that target until the end of their next turn. If any [DA] were used to generate [FP] and the check succeeds, the target also suffers a Critical Injury, adding +10 per [FP] spent on the check.

ForceAbility.Name: Oppressive Stasis
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP]. Whenever a target affected by Bind takes an action, that target suffers strain equal to Willpower.

ForceAbility.Name: Powerful Stasis
ForceAbility.Description: When using the Bind Power, the user may make a [B]Discipline check[b] as part of the pool. On success and power activation, they may immobilize a powerful and/or complex object, such as a waterfall or a spinning mechanism. The difficulty of the check is determined by the size and power of the target.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to increase power's maximum range bands by one, to maximum of Extreme. This may be activated multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When the user activates the Range upgrade, they increase the maximum range band of the power by two instead of 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase the maximum silhouette of targets by 1, to a maximum of 4. This may be activated multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Move Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user can use the Force to lift small objects and willing beings via the power of the Force: [BR]The user may spend [FP] to move one object or willing ally of silhouette 0 that is within short range up to their maximum range, with a default maximum range of short range.

ForceAbility.Name: Extricate
ForceAbility.Description: The user gains the ability to pull objects off secure mountings or from an opponent's grasp.

ForceAbility.Name: Floating Bulwark
ForceAbility.Description: After successfully activating the base power, the user may commit a number of [FO] up to the greatest silhouette among target objects to use objects of equal silhouette as cover, the user gains ranged defense equal to the silhouette. Per GM discretion, silhouette 3 or greater cover may make attacking the user or attacks from the user's position impossible, and may protect engaged characters. An additional character may be defended per each additional target object, as long as they stay within the maximum range of the power. The objects remain as long as [FO] remains committed.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to increase targets affected by 1. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When activating the Magnitude upgrade, the user may spend additional [FP][FP] to increase the number of targets by half the user's Willpower, rounded up, instead of 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to use the Move power on non-willing living beings as if they were objects, including as objects to hurl at other foes, dealing damage to both. If only [LI] were used to generate [FP], the user may have any damage dealt by Move to be treated as strain damage. If only [DA] were used, all targets of Move attacks suffer a critical injury, adding +10 times the user's Willpower to the results.

ForceAbility.Name: Precise Control
ForceAbility.Description: The user may finely manipulate objects, allowing them to do whatever they could normally do with their hands to a held item. If this power is used to manipulate something such as a datapad or computer terminal, the controls count as a silhouette 0 object.

ForceAbility.Name: Push / Propel
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user can choose to either hurl objects to damage targets, or hurl blasts of Force directly at targets by making a [B]ranged combat check using the Discipline skill[b] combined with a Move power check, but must still spend enough [FP] to move the object or target: [P][B]Object:[b] The difficulty of the attack is equal to the greatest silhouette among hurled objects. On success and power activation, the attack does damage to the target based on the silhouette of the object + [SU]. Silhouette 0 deals base 5 damage, and each silhouette beyond deals 5 more damage than the last. Successful attacks using Silhouette 3 or greater deal damage to all characters within short range of the target, per GM discretion. The user may use multiple objects to hit one or more targets, they may do so as if the attack had the Auto-fire quality. [P][B] Force:[b] The difficulty of the attack is based on the range of the foe from the user. On success and activation, the target moves one range band away from the user and is knocked down. If the target collides with an immovable object of the same or larger silhouette, they take damage as if they were struck by an object of their own silhouette, using the damage calculation above.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to increase power's range by 1 range band, to a maximum of Extreme. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the power's range by 1 range band, to a maximum of Extreme. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter before or after a character acts, the user may suffer 3 strain to use the Move power as an out-of-turn incidental, may not make an attack. The user may target a foe within range with the basic power to interfere with an action. If that action was not an opposed check, it becomes opposed by the user's Discipline.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to increase silhouette able to be targeted by 1, to a maximum Silhouette equal to the user's Willpower.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: The first time the user activates Strength each round, increase silhouette able to be targeted by 2 instead.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength (Supreme)
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session when activating the Strength upgrade, the user may spend [FP][FP] instead to increase the silhouette able to be targeted by user’s Willpower, to a maximum of Silhouette 5 (this supersedes previous maximums).

ForceAbility.Name: Enhance Basic Power (reSpecialized)
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Take a Force Leap Action:[b] Make an Enhance power check. The user may spend [FP] to jump to any location within short range, both horizontally and vertically, and may be used to leap over obstacles.

ForceAbility.Name: Combat Momentum
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter, after using Force Leap to engage a foe, the next attack the user makes this round against that foe ignores that foe's melee defense.

ForceAbility.Name: Controlled Fall
ForceAbility.Description: When making a check to reduce fall damage, may make an Enhance force check as part of the pool. The user may spend [FP] to decrease the fall by one range band. The user may activate this multiple times. If the fall is reduced to less than short, the user suffers no effects from falling. Any falls longer than Planetary Short are treated as Planetary Short.

ForceAbility.Name: Enhanced Agility
ForceAbility.Description: As a maneuver, commit [FO]. The user increases their Agility characteristics by 1 (to a maximum of 6).

ForceAbility.Name: Enhanced Brawn
ForceAbility.Description: As a maneuver, commit [FO]. The user increases their Brawn characteristics by 1 (to a maximum of 6).

ForceAbility.Name: Enhanced Athletics
ForceAbility.Description: When making an Athletics check, the Force user may roll an [B]Enhance power check[b] as part of the pool. The user may spend [FP] to add [SU] or [AD] to the results. Each symbol may only be added once.

ForceAbility.Name: Enhanced Brawl
ForceAbility.Description: Enhance can be used with the Brawl Skill.

ForceAbility.Name: Enhanced Coordination
ForceAbility.Description: Enhance can be used with the Coordination skill.

ForceAbility.Name: Enhanced Piloting
ForceAbility.Description: Enhance can be used with the Piloting (Planetary) or Piloting (Space) skills.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session when making a combined [B]Enhance power check[b], the user may spend [FP][FP][FP] to immediately take another action.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase Force Leap's range by one range band, to a maximum of Medium.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed
ForceAbility.Description: The user may perform Force Leap as a maneuver instead of as an action.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter, immediately before or after a character acts, suffer 3 strain to perform Force Leap as an out of turn incidental.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to a [B]combined Enhance power check[b], separately and in addition to the Basic Power. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Influence Basic Power (reSpecialized)
ForceAbility.Description: The character may attempt to guide, shape, and even dominate the thoughts and feelings of others: [P][B]Mind Trick:[b] The user may make an [B]opposed Discipline vs. Discipline check[b] against an engaged target combined with an [B]Influence power check.[b] If the user spends [FP] and succeeds on the check, they can force the target to adopt an emotional state or believe something untrue, lasting for 1 round or 5 minutes. The difficulty of the check is determined by the target with the highest Discipline ranks, or set by the GM based on the number of minds affected.

ForceAbility.Name: Empowered Deception
ForceAbility.Description: When making a Deception check, the user may roll an [B]Influence power check[b] as part of the dice pool, and may spend [FP] to gain [SU] or [AD] on the check, but only one of each symbol.

ForceAbility.Name: Empowered Charm
ForceAbility.Description: Influence can be used to make combined Charm power checks.

ForceAbility.Name: Clouded Mind
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to add [FA] to each check made by each target for the duration of Mind Trick. This may be activated multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Empowered Leadership
ForceAbility.Description: Influence can be used to make combined Leadership checks.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: The user may commit [FO][FO] after the successful activation of the power to maintain the effects of Mind Trick for as long as they remain committed, or until the end of the current encounter. If a target becomes out of range of the power, the effect persists until the end of their next turn.

ForceAbility.Name: Empowered Negotiation
ForceAbility.Description: Influence can be used to make combined Negotiations power checks.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to choose additional targets equal to the user's Force rating.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When activating the Magnitude upgrade, spend [FP][FP][FP] instead to affect any number of characters within range. How this affects a large number of characters is up to GM discretion.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session, spend a number of [FP] depending on NPC type. If no [DA] were spent, the target of Mind Trick is completely pacified. If no [LI] were spent, they are sent into a violent rage or terrified stupor. The user may effect a minion group by spending [FP], a rival by spending [FP][FP], or a Nemesis whose current strain is greater than half of their strain threshold by spending [FP][FP][FP][FP]. How the character behaves in this state is GM discretion., but their role should meaningfully change their role, or be removed entirely, from the encounter.

ForceAbility.Name: Empowered Coercion
ForceAbility.Description: Influence can be used to make combined Coercion power checks.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the maximum range of the Influence power by one range band, to a maximum of extreme.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When activating the Range upgrade, increase the maximum range by two range bands instead of one.

ForceAbility.Name: Subdue / Uplift
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to have the targets suffer or recover a number of strain equal to the user's Force rating.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to a [B]combined Influence power check[b] using a social skill, separately and in addition to the Basic Power. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Sense Basic Power (reSpecialized)
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user can sense the Force interacting with the world around them, allowing them to sense being and the emotions in the following ways: [P]The user may spend [FP] to sense all living beings within short range (including sentient and non-sentient beings). [P]The user may spend [FP] to sense the current emotional state of one living target within whom they are engaged.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: Sense's ongoing effects may be triggered one additional time per round.

ForceAbility.Name: Escape Danger
ForceAbility.Description: When Threat Sense triggers, the user may spend 2 strain to make a Move maneuver as an out-of-turn incidental after the triggering attack has been resolved.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase the number of targets affected by power equal to the user's current Force Rating. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When activating the Magnitude upgrade, the user may instead spend [FP][FP][FP] to affect all characters within range of the power.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session, make a [B]Sense power check[b] combined with an [B]opposed Discipline vs. Discipline check[b] against a living target within range. If the check succeeds, spend [FP] to ask the GM a number of simple questions that the target's mind could answer equal to [FP] spent this way. If [FP] generated from [DA] were spent, the target suffers strain equal to total [FP] spent on the power.

ForceAbility.Name: Protective Instincts
ForceAbility.Description: When an ally engaged with the user becomes the target of an attack while committing [FO] to Threat Sense, the user may choose to upgrade the pool of the check as if they were being attacked. This counts against the number of times Threat Sense can trigger each round.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase the power's range by one range band.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When activating the Range upgrade, increase the maximum range by 2 instead of 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Sense Opening
ForceAbility.Description: Ongoing effect: As a maneuver, commit [FO]. Once per round, when the Force user makes a combat check, upgrade the ability of the pool once.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter, when targeted by an attack, the user may commit [FO] to Threat Sense as an out of turn incidental. The attack still triggers Threat Sense, upgrading the pool.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: When using Sense's ongoing effects, upgrade the pool twice instead of once.

ForceAbility.Name: Surface Reading
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to sense the current thoughts of one living target whom the user is engaged with. This effect does not benefit from the Magnitude upgrade. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Threat Sense
ForceAbility.Description: Ongoing effect: As a maneuver, commit [FO]. Once per round, when an attack targets the user, upgrade the difficulty of the pool once.

ForceAbility.Name: Protect / Unleash (reSpecialized) Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user guides the flow of energy, protecting themselves and others or unleashing blasts of power upon their foes: [P][B]Protect:[b] The user chooses themself or one ally they are currently engaged with and makes a [B]Protect power check[b] and rolls an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Discipline check[b] as part of the pool. Spend [FP] to reduce damage from a single hit of an attack that hits the affected target by an amount equal to the user's Willpower. This effect lasts until the beginning of the user's next turn. [P][B]Unleash:[b] The user makes an Unleash power check as a ranged attack and rolls an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Discipline check[b] as a part of the pool. If the check succeeds and the user spends [FP], the attack hits. It has a range of short, a base damage equal to Willpower, and a critical rating of 4. The difficulty of the check increases normally with range, but may never be easier than [B]Average ([DI][DI])[b]. The user gains 1 Conflict.

ForceAbility.Name: Bolster / Burden
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Protect:[b] Spend [AD] to have the target gain defense equal to [AD] spent. This may be activated multiple times. [P][B]Unleash:[b] Spend [AD] to inflict 1 strain on a foe successfully hit by the attack. This may be activated multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Deter / Delay
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Protect:[b] Spend [FP]. Foes must suffer 2 strain to engage affected targets for the duration of the power. [P][B]Unleash:[b] Spend [FP] to give the attack Ensnare rating equal to the user's Force Rating.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Protect:[b] If no [DA] were spent to generate [FP], the power reduces damage of each attack hitting the target for the duration of the power. Protect expires on the target at the start of the target's next turn after they were succesfully attacked once. [P][B]Unleash:[b] If no [LI] were spent to generate [FP], the attack gains Burn 2.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Protect:[b] The user may spend [FP][FP] to affect 1 additional target within range. The user may still only reduce damage from one hit among all affected targets. This may be activated multiple times. [P][B]Unleash:[b] The user may spend [FP][FP] to inflict an additional hit on a target engaged with the original target. These hits may deal the same damage as the initial hit. Each target may only be hit once. This may be activated multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Protect:[b] Protect reduces the damage of one attack per each affected target, instead of one attack total. [P][B]Unleash:[b] Additional hits from the attack may be assigned to any foe within range, instead of those engaged with the original target.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude (Supreme)
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Protect:[b] Once per session, spend [FP][FP][FP] to protect all allies within short range as if Magnitude has been activated for each of them. Magnitude may still be activated to affect additional targets beyond short range. [P][B]Unleash:[b] Once per session, spend [FP][FP][FP] to give the attack a Blast rating equal to the user's Willpower. Each successful hit must trigger Blast separately.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Protect:[b] Spend [FP][FP] to reflect all attacks that would be reduced to 0 damage (before soak) by this power back upon their sources. Each attack reflected this way hits the attacker for the amount of damage it would have dealt to the user (before the deduction for Protect). [P][B]Unleash:[b] The user may spend [FP] to give the attack Linked 1, a Critical Rating of 1, or Pierce with a rating equal to Willpower.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the power's maximum range by one range band. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When the user activates the Range upgrade, they increase the maximum range of the power by 2 range bands instead of 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Protect:[b] Once per session, spend a Destiny Point to use Protect as an out-of-turn incidental. [P][B]Unleash:[b] Once per session, spend a Destiny Point to use Unleash as a maneuver.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Protect:[b] Spend [FP] to reduce damage from incoming attacks by a number equal to the user's Willpower plus [SU], instead of their Willpower. [P][B]Unleash:[b] Spend [FP] to set the attack's base damage equal to the user's Willpower plus their Force Rating instead of their Willpower.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Protect:[b] Once per encounter when activating Strength, the user may instead spend [FP][FP] to reduce damage by twice Willpower plus [SU]. [P][B]Unleash:[b] Once per encounter when activating Strength, the user may instead spend [FP][FP] to set the attack's base damage equal to twice the user's Willpower plus their Force Rating.

ForceAbility.Name: Empathy
