ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to decrease the difficulty of the next social check targeting a character whose emotions or thoughts the user has sensed this encounter.

ForceAbility.Name: Ebb/Flow Basic Power (reSpecialized)
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user becomes a conduit for the Will of the Force, empowering allies and bringing misfortune to foes. Which power the user activates is determined by the Destiny Pool: [P][B]Ebb:[b] If the Destiny Pool has more Dark Side than Light Side Points, or is evenly split, the user may spend [FP] to add [FA] to each check that has its difficulty upgrade by a player-spent Destiny Point until the end of the next round. [P][B]Flow:[b] If the Destiny Pool has more Light Side Points than Dark Side Points, the user may spend [FP] to add [SU] to each check that has its ability upgraded by a player-spent Destiny Point until the end of the next round.

ForceAbility.Name: Attunement
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Ebb:[b] For the duration of this power, while there are fewer Light Side Points than Dark in the Destiny Pool, or they are equal, the user adds [DA] to all Force Power checks. [P][B]Flow:[b] For the duration of the power, while there are fewer Dark Side Points than Light Side Points in the Destiny Pool, the user adds [LI] to all Force power checks.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: The user may commit [FO][FO] after successfully activating the Basic Power to maintain the effects of Ebb/Flow while they remain committed, or until the end of the encounter.

ForceAbility.Name: Erode/Expand
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Ebb:[b] Foes within engaged range of the user add [SE] to checks they make for the duration of the power. [P][B]Flow:[b] Allies within engaged range of the user add [BO] to checks they make for the duration of the power.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter, the user or an ally may spend an additional Destiny Point to upgrade the difficulty or ability of a single check. This applies the effects of Ebb/Flow twice.

ForceAbility.Name: Oneness of the Force
ForceAbility.Description: The first time the user successfully activates the Basic Power of Ebb/Flow each session, they add a Light Side Point to the Destiny Pool.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase the range at which characters add [BO] or [SE] to checks from the effects of Ebb/Flow by 1 range band. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When activating Range, increase the maximum range of the power by 2 range bands instead of 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Restore Balance
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter, the user may spend [FP][FP] to change a Dark Side Point in the Destiny Pool to a Light Side Point, or vice versa.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed
ForceAbility.Description: Once per round, the user may perform the Ebb/Flow Power check as a maneuver. If they successfully activate the Basic power, they may not activate it again during this turn.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Ebb:[b] Spend [FP] to add [FA][TH] to checks whose difficulty has been upgraded by a player-spent Destiny Point instead of [FA]. [P][B]Flow:[b] The user may spend [FP] to add [SU][AD] to checks whose ability has been upgraded by a player-spent Destiny Point instead of [SU].

ForceAbility.Name: Strength (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session, the user may spend [FP][FP][FP] to double the symbols added to the first check affected by Ebb/Flow. This does not double [SU] resulting from [TR] or [FA] resulting from [DE], but may double [TR] or [DE].

ForceAbility.Name: True Conduit
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Ebb:[b] Once per encounter, if no [LI] were used to generate [FP], add [DE] to an affected check. [P][B]Flow:[b] Once per encounter, if no [DA] were spent to generate [FP], add [TR] to an affected check.

ForceAbility.Name: Wane/Wax
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Ebb:[b] When a player spends a Destiny Point while this power is active, all foes within the encounter suffer 1 strain. [P][B]Flow:[b] When a player spends a Destiny Point while this power is active, all allies within the encounter recover 1 strain.

ForceAbility.Name: Conjure Basic Power (reSpecialized)
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user calls forth a spectral object to their hand, which lasts for a short time: [P]The user may spend [FP] to create a facsimile of a Brawl or Melee weapon within engaged range, using the following profile: (Brawl or Melee; Damage +3; Critical Rating 3; Range [Engaged]; Cortosis). At the end of the next turn, the item dissipates. At the GM's discretion, the user can instead conjure a simple tool or other useful low-tech item with an encumbrance no greater than 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Dangerous Weapon
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user gains the ability to imbue a created weapon with certain offensive qualities that might manifest as a palpable darkness around the item, a keening wail whenever the weapon is swung, or ethereal green flames. Spend [FP] to grant one conjured weapon one of the following qualities: Burn 3, Pierce 3, or Vicious 3. The user can activate this multiple times, granting the weapon an additional quality each time (but may not grant the same quality more than once).

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: After successfully activating the Basic Power, the user may commit [FO] to sustain a single conjured weapon or tool while it remains in Short Range. The user may commit additional [FO] to sustain additional conjured items and tools this way.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: The user may commit [FO][FO] after successfully activating the Mastery to sustain a conjured creature or item while it remains within medium range. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Empowered Implement
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to the first check made using the conjured item, or made by the conjured creature.

ForceAbility.Name: Imbued Implement
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP][FP] to increase another Force user's Force Rating by 1 while they wield an item conjured by the character.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to conjure an additional tool, weapon, or conjured creature. The user may choose different effects from activated upgrades for each object conjured. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Ongoing effect: Instead of activating the Basic Power, the user may spend [FP][FP][FP] to conjure a facsimile of a Silhouette 1 creature instead of an object. This creature is mindlessly bound to the user's will, and mindlessly follows the user's command until the end of the user's next turn, at which point it will dissipate. This creature using the profile of a living minion NPC of the user's choice, except they have the following attack profile: (Brawl or Melee; Damage +5; Critical Rating 3; Range [Engaged]; Cortosis). Upgrades that affect conjured weapons affect this attack. Once per round, the user may perform a maneuver to grant the conjured creature a maneuver and an action. [P] If, however, the user has a corpse of silhouette 1 or smaller available, they can instead animate it, bringing it to false life and gaining 7 conflict in the process. This abomination uses the profile of the deceased being, obeys the will of the Force user, and ceases to be animated at the end of the user's next turn. The user may spend a maneuver to direct the corpse, allowing it to spend an action and a maneuver.

ForceAbility.Name: Mercy / Cruelty
ForceAbility.Description: If no [DA] were spent, the user may increase the conjured weapon's (or conjured creature's attack) damage by 5 and have it gain the Stun Damage quality. If no [LI] were spent, reduce the weapon's (or conjured creature's attack's) critical rating by 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Perfected Form
ForceAbility.Description: Weapons, tools, and other objects the user conjures appear genuine and accurate to the form they represent. A perception check with a difficulty equal to the user's Force Rating is required to determine its falsity. Additionally, a wielder of the user’s conjured weapon may make attack checks using the Lightsaber skill, and may be used with the Reflect or Deflect talents.

ForceAbility.Name: Protective Weapon
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user gains the ability to imbue a created weapon with certain defensive qualities, which might manifest around the item as a blurred protective aura, a form that twists and shifts to protect the wielder, or a halo of crackling energy. Spend [FP] to grant one conjured weapon one of the following qualities: Defensive 1, Deflection 1, or Stun 4. The user can activate this multiple times, granting the weapon an additional quality each time (but may not grant the same quality more than once).

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to extend the range at which conjured objects may be maintained by the user by 1 range band. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When the user activates the Range upgrade, increase the maximum range within which a user may sustain a construct by 2 range bands instead of 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter, the user may spend 3 strain to activate the basic power as an incidental to conjure a tool or weapon.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP][FP] to increase a conjured object's encumbrance by 1 and damage by 3 if it is a weapon, or increase its silhouette by 1 and damage by 5 if it is a conjured creature.

ForceAbility.Name: Shatterpoint
ForceAbility.Description: The power gains the ongoing effect: as a maneuver, commit [FO][FO][FO]. The user’s attacks gain Pierce with a rating equal to Cunning plus their ranks in Perception. If the character is using a starship or vehicle weapon and the Pierce rating is less than 10, increase Breach rating by 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Seeker's Sight
ForceAbility.Description: As a maneuver, commit [FO]. Upgrade the ability of Vigilance and Perception checks once.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: The user may commit [FO] after successfully activating the base power to continue tracking or remove [SE] imposed due to cover, concealment, defense, or illusory effects from attacks against a target even when it moves.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to track or remove [SE] from attacks targeting one additional target.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: The user scans the target with their mind, following the flow of energy to the flaw that will be their undoing. The user may spend [FP][FP][FP] to add [TR] to combat checks they make against and checks they make to track or chase against one target of Seek while the power is active.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to gain additional details about the target’s location or direction, or remove additional [SE] from attacks the user makes against a personal-scale target equal to the user’s Force rating. The nature and type of details are per GM discretion, such as sensation, sounds, smells, or Force visions. Alternatively, the user may spend [FP][FP] to remove additional setbacks from attacks the user makes against a starship or vehicle target equal to the user’s Force rating instead.

ForceAbility.Name: Seek Truth
ForceAbility.Description: The user may make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) Perception or Vigilance check (or opposed Perception or Vigilance vs Deception)[b] to see through all sensory misdirections confronting them, whether from technology or more esoteric means. This power dispels cloaking fields, holograms, Force Illusions, and even physical disguises, but does not reveal the truth of spoken or written lies. If the check is successful, the user may spend any number of [FP] to see through that many illusory effects.

ForceAbility.Name: Seek the Unknown
ForceAbility.Description: When activating the Basic power, may instead spend [FP] instead of [FP][FP] to gain insight into lost or unknown people’s location or direction.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When activating Magnitude, the user tracks or removes [SE] from additional targets equal to Force Rating instead.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter, the user may spend a Destiny Point to perform the Seek Power as a maneuver. If the user does, they may not activate the Seek power again this round.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When activating Strength, additional details gained to track a character are of a type of the user’s choice rather than the GM’s. If more [SE] imposed by concealment, cover, defenses, or illusory sources would be removed from the user’s check to attack a target than there are [SE] on the check, add [BO] equal to the difference to the next attack the user makes against the target.

ForceAbility.Name: Endure Basic Power (reSpecialized)
ForceAbility.Description: When the Force user suffers a Critical Injury with a severity no greater than [B]Easy ([DI])[b], the user may activate Endure as an out-of-turn incidental, committing [FO]. While the [FO] remains committed, the character ignores the effects of that Critical Injury, including adding +10 to further rolls on the Critical Injury Result table. The injury can still be healed while it is being ignored. When this ongoing effect ends, the character suffers all effects of the Critical Injury (unless it has been healed). If this Critical Injury is a result of being incapacitated, the user may still commit [FO] to activate Endure, but the effect ends at the end of the encounter if the user remains incapacitated.

ForceAbility.Name: Endure Scars
ForceAbility.Description: As an incidental, the user may activate Endure to temporarily ignore the effects of a previously suffered Critical Injury.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: The user may commit one additional [FO] to temporarily ignore the effects of one additional Critical Injury while the [FO] remains committed. Endure must be separately activated for each Critical Injury.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Once per Session, the user can use Endure to temporarily ignore the Critical Injury result of Dead. The difficulty of the Dead Critical Injury is considered to be [B]Formidable ([DI][DI][DI][DI][DI])[b] when avoiding suffering it or healing it through any means.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: The user can use Endure to temporarily ignore the effects of Critical Injuries with a Severity of [B]Medium ([DI][DI])[b].

ForceAbility.Name: Overcome Elements
ForceAbility.Description: As an incidental, the user may commit one or more [FO] to temporarily ignore hostile the effects of environments with rating less than twice the number of [FO] committed this way. Alternatively, the user may commit [FO][FO][FO] to ignore the effects of vacuum, atmospheric pressure, or drowning.

ForceAbility.Name: Empowered Resilience
ForceAbility.Description: When making an Resilience check, the Force user may roll an Endure power check as part of the pool. The user may spend [FP] to add [SU] or [AD] to the results. Each symbol may only be added once.

ForceAbility.Name: Overcome Injury
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter when suffering a critical injury, the user may make an Endure power check and roll a Resilience check with a difficulty equal to the severity of the Critical Injury as part of the Pool. If the user succeeds, they may spend [FP] equal to the Severity of the Critical Injury to not suffer the Critical Injury.

ForceAbility.Name: Endure Exhaustion
ForceAbility.Description: As an incidental, the user may commit [FO] to temporarily ignore the negative effects of exhaustion, hunger, or thirst. If at any point the user ceases committing [FO] to this upgrade, the negative effects immediately resume.

ForceAbility.Name: Overcome Weakness
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter while suffering a status effect, as a maneuver, make an Endure Power check. Spend [FP][FP] to end a status effect the character is suffering. Status effects may include but aren't limited to Immobilized, Restrained, Poisoned, Staggered, Burned, Disorient. The user may perform this maneuver even while immobilized or suffering another restrictive status condition.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: The user may commit additional [FO] to temporarily ignore a number of Critical Injuries up to the user’s Brawn, rather than one additional Critical Injury. Endure must be separately activated for each Critical Injury.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: The user can use Endure to temporarily ignore the effects of Critical Injuries with a Severity of [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI])[b]. Additionally, when activating Empowered Resilience, the user may spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to the check, and may do so multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength (Supreme)
ForceAbility.Description: The user can use Endure to temporarily ignore the effects of Critical Injuries with a Severity of [B]Daunting ([DI][DI][DI][DI])[b].

ForceAbility.Name: Farsight Basic Power (reSpecialized)
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user expands normal visual senses through a connection to the Force. [P]The user may spend [FP] to ignore the effects of darkness or blindness and see normally at up to medium range until the end of the next round. This allows the user to view everything most sentients would normally be able to see on a well-lit day. This removes any negative effects of said darkness or concealment.

ForceAbility.Name: Absolute Sight
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to see in every direction simultaneously, noticing and observing things in a full 360-degree arc. Add [BO][BO] to all Vigilance checks the user makes, and [SE][SE] to all Stealth and Skulduggery checks the user opposes, while the power is active.

ForceAbility.Name: Discerning Sight
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to make out fine details on a single object within medium range, or microscopic details on a single object within engaged range. Decrease the difficulty of any check the user makes to inspect or investigate this object once. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Empowered Sight
ForceAbility.Description: When making a Perception or Vigilance check, the Force user may roll an Farsight power check as part of the pool. The user may spend [FP] to add [SU] or [AD] to the results. Each symbol may only be added once.

ForceAbility.Name: Piercing Sight
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to see through one object within range as if it were transparent. Ignore the effects that cover, concealment, or defense this object would grant a target of a combat, Perception, or Vigilance check the character makes. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Sight Without End
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP][FP]. The user can see as though from a spot within close range (planetary range) of the user’s body. This may be any direction from the user, horizontal and/or vertical.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP][FP][FP]. When making a Force power check, the user may treat any space that Farsight allows them to see as the originating point of the power. Which power checks or combined power checks this can apply to is up to GM discretion.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: The user may commit [FO] to sustain the effects of Farsight.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the range of the basic power by 1 range band. Additionally, increase the maximum range of Effortless Sight to long range. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Effortless Sight
ForceAbility.Description: The user may treat their vision as if the Basic power is always active. To gain the benefit of any other upgrade, the user must activate the power as normal. Effects that limit or disrupt the user's use of the force may affect this upgrade, per GM discretion.

ForceAbility.Name: Sight & Sound
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to choose a single source of sound within the range of Farsight. The user hears all sound that source creates as if it is at a conversational volume directed at them. The scope of a source could be an object, conversation, or individual, per GM discretion.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When the user activates the Range upgrade, increase the maximum range of the power by two range bands instead of one. Additionally, increase the maximum range of Effortless Sight to extreme range.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter, the user may perform the Farsight action as a maneuver. If the user does, they may not activate Farsight again this round.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: When activating Empowered Sight, the user may spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to the check, and may do so multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Foresee Basic Power (reSpecialized)
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to gain vague hints of personal events to come in the following scene or encounter. Additional [FP] may be spent to increase the distance from the present moment the character may foresee, per GM discretion. For example, [FP][FP] may be spent to gain vague hints of the user’s coming day, whereas [FP][FP][FP][FP] may be spent to gain vague hints of the user’s coming week or fortnight.

ForceAbility.Name: Strife Foreseen
ForceAbility.Description: When the user and/or allies make a skill check to determine initiative, the user may roll a [B]Foresee power check[b] as part of the pool. They may spend [FP] to add [SU] to their check or engaged ally's check. When activating multiple times, the same character must be chosen.

ForceAbility.Name: Maneuver Foreseen
ForceAbility.Description: When performing a [B]Foresee power check[b] as part of an Initiative check, the user may spend [FP] to allow all affected targets to take one free maneuver before the first round of combat begins.

ForceAbility.Name: Protective Portent
ForceAbility.Description: Affected targets increase their ranged and melee defense by 2 for the first round of combat.

ForceAbility.Name: Continuity
ForceAbility.Description: Reduce the [FP] cost to activate the Basic Power by [FP], to a minimum of [FP].

ForceAbility.Name: Clarity
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to pick out a specific detail from their vision. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to affect an additional engaged ally (or themselves, if not the original target). The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the range at which they can affect their allies with the power by a single range band. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: Once per check, if the user has gained specific details pertaining to the check they are making, they may suffer 2 strain to add [SU] to the result. How relevant the detail must be to the check it must be to qualify is per GM discretion.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: Once per [B]Foresee power check[b] when activating Magnitude, the user increases the number of engaged allies that are affected by the user’s Force rating instead of 1. Subsequent activations on the same check increase the number of affected allies by 1 as normal.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session before a check is made, may spend [FP][FP] and make a [B]Hard ([DI][DI][DI]) Cool or Vigilance check[b] with a combined Foresee Force power check as an out of turn incidental. On success, the user may spend [FP][FP] to add [TR] or [DE] to that check. The user must establish what previously unestablished portent they have foreseen that caused this result.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When activating the Range upgrade, the user may increase the maximum range by two range bands instead of 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When the user activates Strength, they also [AD] to the check.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Redirection
ForceAbility.Description: When you are targeted by a ranged combat check by an adversary, you may spend [TH][TH][TH] or [DE] to have the attack instead hit a target engaged with you that is not the original attacker. You may also have the attack miss you instead.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: You may spend [FP] to increase the range of Redirection by 1 range band per [FP] spent up to Long. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Control: Blurred Momentum
ForceAbility.Description: Once per round when targeted by a combat check while this power is active, you may suffer 1 strain as an out of turn incidental to add either [FA] or [TH] to the roll. You may suffer strain in this way up to your Force Rating.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to allow uses of Redirection to hit an additional target within range.

ForceAbility.Name: Perfect Dodge
ForceAbility.Description: Once per round when you are targeted by a combat check you can use Redirection on, you may add [TH] to the results after the roll. You may spend 1 strain to add additional [TH] to the result. You may take strain in this way up to your Force Rating.

ForceAbility.Name: Mend / Mutilate
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Heal:[b] The user may make a [B]Heal power check[b] combined with a Medicine check with a difficulty chosen by the user. If the check succeeds, one target who heals wounds also heals one Critical Injury with a severity equal to or less than the difficulty of the Medicine check. [P][B]Harm:[b] The user may make a [B]Harm power check[b] combined with an [B]opposed Medicine vs. Resilience check[b]. If the check succeeds, one target who suffers wounds also suffers one Critical Injury. The user may spend [AD][AD] to add +10 to the roll per [AD][AD] spent this way.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter, the user may suffer 3 strain to perform Heal or Harm as a maneuver. If the user does, they may not activate the power again this turn.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to heal or inflict an additional number of wounds equal to the user's Force rating or ranks in Medicine, whichever is higher. This effect may not be activated multiple times. Additionally, when activating Empowered Medicine, the user may spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to the check, and may do so multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Convalesce / Consume
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Heal:[b] The user may spend [FP] to immediately remove a status effect (including but not limited to the staggered, immobilized, or disoriented condition, and effects such as narrative crippling, poisons) from one target of the power. The user may activate this upgrade multiple times. [P][B]Harm:[b] The user may spend [FP] to heal wounds equal to wounds inflicted on target. This counts as a use of a stimpack on the target of the healing. The character healed this way gains 1 Conflict. The user may activate this upgrade multiple times, but must select a different target to be healed each time.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session when activating Magnitude, the user may instead spend [FP][FP][FP] to affect any number of characters within range.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: As a maneuver, the user may choose Heal or Harm, then commit one or more [FO] to this check: [P][B]Heal:[b] At the beginning of the user’s turn, engaged allies recover wounds equal to the number of [FO] committed to this effect. This does not count as a use of a Stimpack for the affected characters. [P][B]Harm:[b] At the beginning of the user’s turn, engaged foes suffer wounds equal to the number of [FO] committed. [P]The user may not commit [FO] to both effects at the same time. When the user commits to Harm, they suffer 1 Conflict. Additionally, when an ally passively recovers wounds within 24 hours of being actively healed by the user’s Heal power, they recover additional wounds equal to the user’s Force Rating.

ForceAbility.Name: Sympathy / Spite
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Heal:[b] If no [DA] generated [FP], the target heals strain equal to wounds healed. [P][B]Harm:[b] If any [DA] generated [FP], user heals strain equal to wounds inflicted on the target.

ForceAbility.Name: Heal/Harm Basic Power (reSpecialized)
ForceAbility.Description: The Force User bolsters their ally with renewed vigor or saps their foe of vital energy: [P][B]Heal:[b] The user may spend [FP] to heal a number of wounds equal to the user's Intellect, rounded up, from an engaged living creature (including the user). When the user heals another living creature, that creature suffers 1 strain for each [FP] spent to generate [FP]. This counts as a use of a stimpack on the affected target. This means a single target may only benefit from five uses of Heal over a twenty-four-hour period and [their] uses of Heal also count against the limit on uses of stimpacks (and vice versa). [P][B]Harm:[b] The user may spend [FP] to inflict a number of wounds (ignoring soak) equal to the user's Intellect, rounded up, to an engaged living target. The user gains 1 Conflict.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Heal:[b] Once per encounter after successfully activating the Basic power, the user may choose to have each target that healed wounds increase their Wound Threshold by the user's Force rating until the end of the encounter. [P][B]Harm:[b] Once per encounter, when this power kills a target, the user may choose to increase the user's Force rating by the killed target Force rating until the end of the user’s next turn. If the killed target's doesn't have a Force rating, the user may increase it by 1 instead. The user suffers 5 Conflict.

ForceAbility.Name: Empowered Medicine
ForceAbility.Description: When making a Medicine check, or another check to help a living creature recover wounds, the Force user may roll an Heal power check as part of the pool. The user may spend [FP] to add [SU] or [AD] to the results. Each symbol may only be added once.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When activating the Range upgrade, the user may increase the maximum range by two range bands instead of 1. Additionally, increase the maximum range of the Duration upgrade to medium.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to increase power’s range by 1 range band. Additionally, the user increases the maximum range of the Duration upgrade to short. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP][FP] to affect 1 additional target within range. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Alter (reSpecialized) Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: The basic power for Alter allows the user to tap into the living Force of their surroundings, manipulating the nearby environs. The basic power has two uses, the first of which can only be used in natural terrain that can change form easily, such as dirt, sand, mud, and thick vegetation. The second can only be used in a place with an atmosphere, natural or artificial. [P]Spend [FP] to make all terrain currently within short range their choice of normal or difficult terrain until the end of their next turn. The user must be touching the ground to manifest this power. The user may not activate this multiple times. [P]Spend [FP] to give concealment to or remove concealment from all characters within short range until the end of their next turn. When giving concealment, which adds [SE] or [BO] to appropriate checks. The user may not activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Battle Meditation (reSpecialized) Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: The Force User directs allies in moments of crisis and great need, making them more effective as a coordinated unit, or causes dissension in the ranks of foes within range. Choose one of the following options: [P][B]Unify[b]: Spend [FP] to mentally connect a number of friendly targets up to the user’s Presence within medium range until the end of the user's next turn. The user and targets may communicate simple feelings to each other through the Force, and the targets add [AD] each check they make. If the user uses any [DA] to generate [FP], reduce each target’s Willpower by 1 (to a minimum of 1) until the end of encounter. This is not cumulative with repeat use during an encounter. [P][B]Isolate[b]: Spend [FP] to mentally isolate a number of foes up to Presence who are within medium range from one another until the end of the user's next turn, adding [TH] to all checks they make.

ForceAbility.Name: Seek Basic Power (reSpecialized)
ForceAbility.Description: The Force User allows the will of the Force to lead the way to something lost or forgotten, through the path of least resistance: [P]The user may spend [FP] to gain insight into the general direction or location of a person or object that the user is personally familiar with, regardless of current distance. Alternatively, the user may spend [FP][FP] to gain that insight into the location or directions of an unknown or lost person or object. [P]The user may spend [FP] to remove [SE] equal the user’s Force rating from combat checks made against personal-scale targets imposed due to defense, concealment, cover until the end of the user’s next turn. Alternatively, the user may spend [FP][FP] to remove [SE] equal to the user’s Force rating from combat checks made against starships and vehicles until the end of the user’s next turn.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter, the user may suffer 3 strain to perform Manipulate as a maneuver. If they do, they may not activate Manipulate again this turn.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Supreme)
ForceAbility.Description: While the user is aboard a starship or vehicle, they may suffer 2 strain to treat the range of Manipulate as Planetary close when targeting enemy vessels. The range may not be increased past planetary medium.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When activating the Strength upgrade, the Basic power heals or inflicts a number of strain equal to the user's Intellect instead. Additionally, when activating Empowered Technopathy, the user may spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to the check, and may do so multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Mystic Implements
ForceAbility.Description: The character always counts as having the right tools for the job when performing Computers and Mechanics checks. When making a Manipulate power check as part of a Computers or Mechanics check, may activate Range to do so at a distance.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When activating the Range upgrade, the user may increase the maximum range by two range bands instead of 1. Additionally, increase the maximum range of Reinforce Systems and Reinforce / Ruin by 2 range bands.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: Once per Power check, the user may spend [FP] to have the Basic power heal or inflict a number of strain equal to half the user's Intellect, rounded up, instead.

ForceAbility.Name: Disable Droid
ForceAbility.Description: When the user performs a combat check against an engaged droid or mechanical construct, they may make a Dismantle Force check as part of the pool. [P]Alternatively, as an action, the user may make an [B]opposed Computers[b] or [B]Mechanics vs Discipline check[b] targeting a droid, making a combined Dismantle force check as part of the pool. If successful and the droid is within range of the power, the user may spend [FP][FP] to stagger or immobilize it until the end of its next turn, and may spend [FP] to change its short term memory, per GM discretion.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter, when a droid or vessel suffers a Critical Injury or Critical Hit, the user may make a Manipulate Power check as an out of turn incidental. Spend one or more [FP] to increase or decrease the severity of the Critical Injury or Critical Hit by 10 per [FP] spent.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the range of the power by 1 range band. Additionally, increase the maximum range of System Reinforcement and Reinforce / Ruin by 1 range band.

ForceAbility.Name: Systems Reinforcement
ForceAbility.Description: As a maneuver, the user may commit one or more [FO]. Increase either the hull trauma or system strain threshold of an engaged vessel by 3 per [FO] committed. The user may commit to either effects any number or times in any combination.

ForceAbility.Name: Reinforce / Ruin
ForceAbility.Description: As a maneuver commit [FO] to increase or decrease an engaged droid’s soak by 2, or an engaged starship or vehicle’s armor by 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Reconstruct
ForceAbility.Description: As a maneuver, the user may commit [FO]. One damaged weapon or item counts as being unmanaged. The user may do this multiple times, choosing a different damaged item per [FO] committed.

ForceAbility.Name: Empowered Technopathy
ForceAbility.Description: When making a Computers or Mechanics check, the Force user may roll a Manipulate power check as part of the pool. The user may spend [FP] to add [SU] or [AD] to the results. Each symbol may only be added once.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: If a characteristic would be raised above 6 or lowered below 1, the character adds [TR] or [DE] to their next check, respectively.

ForceAbility.Name: Manipulate Basic Power (Respec)
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user shapes machine components on a molecular level, allowing him to mend managed mechanical systems. [P][B]Repair:[b] The Force user may spend [FP] to cause one vehicle or starship they are engaged with to recover one system strain, or one droid to recover 1 strain or wound. If wounds are recovered this way, it counts as a use of a Repair Patch. [P][B]Dismantle:[b] The Force user may spend [FP] to cause one droid, vehicle or starship they are engaged with to suffer one strain or system strain.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When activating the Range upgrade, the user may increase the maximum range by two range bands instead of 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Imbue:[b] Once per encounter, the user may spend a Destiny Point to perform Imbue as a maneuver. [P][B]Exhaust:[b] Once per encounter before a foe acts, the user may spend a Destiny Point to perform Exhaust as an incidental.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When the user activates Duration, they may commit [FO] per character to sustain the effects of Imbue instead of [FO][FO].

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP][FP] to increase or decrease a characteristic of another target within range by 1. This effect counts as their once per encounter effect for the Basic power. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Guided / Bereft
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Imbue:[b] Once per encounter, the user may spend [FP][FP]. One target of the power may suffer 3 strain to immediately take an action as an out of turn incidental. [P][B]Exhaust:[b] Once per encounter, the user may spend [FP][FP]. One target must first suffer 2 strain before taking an action for the duration of the power.

ForceAbility.Name: Transference
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to activate both Imbue and Exhaust as a single Power check, choosing different targets within range for each. The same characteristic must be chosen for each target, and the target(s) of Imbue and the user gain 1 conflict.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase power's range by 1. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase or decrease characteristic by 2 instead of by 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: After activating the Basic power, the user can commit [FO][FO] to sustain the effects of this power on a target as long as the target remains in range. The user may do so multiple times to sustain the power for multiple targets.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Imbue:[b] Once per encounter, if no [DA] were used, one target increases each characteristic by 1 instead. [P][B]Exhaust:[b] Once per encounter, if no [LI] were used, one target decreases each characteristic by 1 instead.

ForceAbility.Name: Imbue Basic Power (Respec)
ForceAbility.Description:
The Force user lends their energy to allies, or saps that energy from foes. This power has two options for use:
[P][B]Imbue:[b] The user may spend [FP] to increase a single characteristic of an engaged character by 1 (to a maximum of 6) until the end of the Force user's next turn. This can only be used once per character per encounter. If the user uses [DA] to generate [FP], the target increases a second characteristic by 1 (to a maximum of 6) until the end of the user's next turn, but both user and target suffer 2 strain. [P][B]Exhaust:[b] The user may spend [FP] to decrease one characteristic of an engaged foe by 1 (to a minimum of 1) until the end of the user's next turn. This can only be used once per character per encounter. If the user uses [DA] to generate [FP], the target decreases a second characteristic by 1 (to a minimum of 1) until the end of the user's next turn, but the user suffers 2 strain.

ForceAbility.Name: Prowess / Weakness
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Imbue:[b] The user may spend [FP] to allow a target to count as having ranks in a single skill equal to the ranks the user has in that skill while the target is affected by this power. The skill must be linked to the characteristics improved by this power. [P][B]Exhaust:[b] The user may spend [FP] to reduce the target’s ranks of a single skill by half, rounded down, while the target is affected by this power. The skill must be linked to the characteristic decreased by this power.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session before a character makes a check, the user may spend a Destiny Point to use Misdirect as an out of turn incidental.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: The first time the user activates Strength per check, increase the maximum silhouette obscured or illusion created twice instead of once. Additionally, when activating Empowered Misdirection, the user may spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to the check, and may do so multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session, the user may spend [FP][FP][FP] to affect any number of targets within range. If the check becomes opposed, the most difficult pool must oppose the user, per GM discretion.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When activating the Range upgrade, the user may increase the maximum range by two range bands instead of 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Greater Illusion
ForceAbility.Description: The user may send [FP][FP] to obscure or create a number of additional illusions equal to their Cunning plus their ranks of Deception.

ForceAbility.Name: Empowered Misdirection
ForceAbility.Description: When making a Deception or Skulduggery check to deceive others, the Force user may roll a Misdirect power check as part of the pool. The user may spend [FP] to add [SU] or [AD] to the results. Each symbol may only be added once.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to increase power's range by 1 range band. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the silhouette of the object obscured or illusion created by 1. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session may make an [B]opposed Deception vs. Vigilance check[b] against a beguiled target to have a created illusion make an action targeting that foe, or to add a [TR] to a social check made by a character who is benefiting from Mask of Deceit targeting that foe. If this action is an attack, it deals damage as strain, with base damage of 5 plus 3 for each Silhouette larger than 1. It has a critical rating of null, and a range appropriate to the illusion. For each additional illusion the user has conjured, add +1 to the damage.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to affect additional targets equal to Cunning. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Mask of Deceit
ForceAbility.Description: Instead of merely hiding an object or person from the target with this power, the user may alter the appearance and sound of that object, person or creature, making it appear to be something or someone else to the target.

ForceAbility.Name: Perceive the Unreal
ForceAbility.Description: Instead of hiding an object or person from the target with this power, the user may make an [B]opposed Deception vs. Vigilance check[b] as part of the pool. On success, may spend [FP] to cause the target to perceive an illusory object, person, or creature of Silhouette 1 or smaller where none exists. The user may create a sourceless sound instead, with a volume equivalent to the maximum silhouette of the power. If [DA] used to generate [FP], each target subjected to the unsettling illusion suffers 1 strain per [FP] spent on the check.

ForceAbility.Name: Confounding Aura
ForceAbility.Description: As a Maneuver, commit one or more [FO]. Add [TH] per [FO] committed to combat checks targeting the user, and to Perception, or Vigilance opposed by the user.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: After successfully activating the basic power, the user may commit [FO][FO] to sustain this power while the beguiled target remains in range. If a target moves beyond the range of a power, the effects end for that target.

ForceAbility.Name: Misdirect Basic Power (Respec)
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user creates illusions to fool those around them. [P]The user may spend [FP] to make a target who is affected by the Force, and is within short range, unable to see or hear a chosen person or object of silhouette 1 or smaller. Until the beginning of the user’s next turn, the target cannot see or sense the hidden person or object. The user acts as if they are Blinded when attacking or attempting to perceive the hidden person or object.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session before a foe makes a check, the user may spend 1 Destiny Point to perform Suppress at an out of turn incidental.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When the user activates the Range upgrade, increase the maximum range of the power by two range bands instead of one.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter, the user may suffer 3 strain to perform Suppress as a maneuver.

ForceAbility.Name: Stillness
ForceAbility.Description: While the user has committed all of their [FO] they upgrade the ability of each check they make once. Force Power checks that commit [FO] as a result of the check after it is made do not benefit from this upgrade.

ForceAbility.Name: Enshroud
ForceAbility.Description: Spend 1 Destiny Point to become undetectable via Force Powers, and make their own powers go unnoticed for the remainder of the encounter. The GM may determine certain uses of the Force, such as attacks or especially obvious displays, cannot be masked or go unnoticed.

ForceAbility.Name: Devoid
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter, whenever a foe fails a Force power check or generates no [FP], the user may suffer 3 strain to add [DE] to the check.

ForceAbility.Name: Nullification
ForceAbility.Description: Suppress now affects all Force power checks made by foes within range instead of only hostile Force power checks targeting the user or their allies within range.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase the power’s range by one range band. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to add additional automatic [FA] to hostile Force power checks.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: As a maneuver, the user may commit [FO] to sustain the ongoing effects of the Basic power on each affected target while they remain within range. If a target moves beyond the range of the power, the effects end for them but not for any other targets affected by the power.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: The user makes a Suppress power check along with an opposed [B]Discipline vs. Discipline check[b] targeting another Force user within short range. If the user spends [FP][FP] and succeeds on the check, the target immediately uncommits all [FO] and ends all ongoing Force powers and Force talents that required committed [FP]. [P]If no [DA] were spent to generate [FP], the target cannot activate Force powers, force talents, or commit [FO] until the end of their next turn. [P]If no [LI] were spent to generate [FP], the user increases their Force rating by a number equal to the number of [FO] uncommitted this way until the end of their next turn.

ForceAbility.Name: Constrain / Corrupt
ForceAbility.Description:
Whenever a foe targets a character affected by Suppress with a Force power, the power gains the following effect, based on the user’s alignment:
[P][B]Light Side User:[b] If that foe used [DA] to generate [FP] on the check, they suffer strain equal to the user’s ranks in Discipline.
[P][B]Dark Side User:[b] The Force user may suffer 2 strain to remove rolled [LI] up to the user’s Discipline and add that many [DA]. The user gains 2 Conflict.

ForceAbility.Name: Total Suppression
ForceAbility.Description: As a maneuver, commit one or more [FO]. When a foe targets the user with a Force power, after the foe generates [FP], the user may reduce the total [FP] generated by 1 per [FO] committed (to a minimum [FP] of 0).

ForceAbility.Name: Suppress Basic Power (Respec)
ForceAbility.Description:
The Force user can dampen the effect of incoming Force powers, dramatically diminishing their effects on themself and their allies.
[P]The Force user may spend [FP] to add automatic [FA] to hostile Force power checks made against them or any ally within short range until the end of their next turn.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Valor:[b] When activating Strength, add [AB][BO] instead. [P][B]Horrify:[b] When activating Strength, instead increase the difficulty of the fear check twice. [P]Additionally, when activating Empowered Will, the user may spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to the check(s), and may do so multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When the user activates Range, they increase the range of the Force power by 2 instead of 1. Additionally, increase the range of Buoy / Bane to long.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter before a character acts, the user may spend a Destiny Point to make a Valor or Horrify check as an out-of-turn incidental.

ForceAbility.Name: Mobilize / Paralyze
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Valor:[b] If the user used no [DA] to generate [FP], each target may suffer 1 strain to immediately perform a maneuver as an out-of-turn incidental. [P][B]Horrify:[b] If the user used no [LI] to generate [FP], each target that fails the fear check caused by this power, or is successfully coerced by a combined Coercion Force power check, loses their free maneuver while suffering the effects of failing that check. This effect ends when the encounter ends or the effects of fear end.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session activating Magnitude, the user may instead spend [FP][FP][FP] to affect any number of characters within range. The user chooses the targets for both Valor and Horrify.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Valor:[b] The user may spend [FP] to add [AB] instead of [BO] to check assisted by this power. [P][B]Horrify:[b] Spend [FP] to increase the difficulty of fear check caused by this power once.

ForceAbility.Name: Buoy / Bane
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Valor:[b] Allies within short range upgrade the ability of checks made to resist fear a number of times equal to half the user's Force rating, rounded up. [P][B]Horrify:[b] Foes within short range upgrade the difficulty of fear checks a number of times equal to half the user's Force rating, rounded up. This includes mundane fear checks and force checks instigated by sources other than the user.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Valor:[b] Once per session when an ally assisted by this power would fail a check, may have them succeed as if they had rolled [SU] instead. [P][B]Horrify:[b] Once per session after a foe fails a fear check caused by this power, the user may have them perform an action as an out of turn incidental. The user gains 3 conflict.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the range of the Force power by 1 range band. Additionally, increase the range of Buoy / Bane and to medium. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Solace / Sadism
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Valor:[b] If a target succeeds on a check assisted by this power, they recover 1 strain. [P][B]Horrify:[b] If a target suffers strain from fear caused by this power, the user may recover that much strain and gain 1 conflict.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to affect an additional character within range. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Valor / Horrify Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: The Force user can bolster their allies and harden their will against fear, or strike fear into the hearts of enemies: [P][B]Valor:[b] Once per round as a maneuver, the user may spend [FP] to assist an ally within short range through the Force, assisting the ally until the user's never turn. This counts as unskilled assistance, but may be considered skilled assistance, per GM discretion. [P][B]Horrify:[b] The user may spend [FP] to force a character within short range to immediately make an [B]Average ([DI][DI]) fear check.[b] The user gains 1 conflict.

ForceAbility.Name: Empowered Will
ForceAbility.Description: [B]Valor:[b] When making a fear check, the user may make a Valor check as part of the pool. The user may spend [FP] to add [SU] and/or [AD] to the check, but may only add each symbol once. [P][B]Horrify:[b] When making a Coercion check, the user may make a Horrify check as part of the pool. The user may spend [FP] to add [SU] and/or [AD] to the check, but may only add each symbol once.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When the user activates the Range upgrade, increase the range by 2 range bands instead of 1.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed
ForceAbility.Description: Once per encounter, the user may suffer 3 strain to perform Insight as a maneuver. If they do, they may not activate Insight again this round.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: Once per round when activating Magnitude, may spend [FP][FP] to affect additional allies or foes equal to the user's Force rating instead.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session after successfully activating the Basic power, the user may spend [FP][FP][FP] to specify the next action one NPC target will take, adding the user’s choice of [SU] or [FA] to any check that character makes until the user’s next turn. Per GM discretion, action should be within the target’s normal characterization and not be obviously suicidal.

ForceAbility.Name: A Step Ahead
ForceAbility.Description: The user adds [BO][BO] to all checks they make against the target until the end of the next round.

ForceAbility.Name: On The Back Foot
ForceAbility.Description: Add [SE][SE] to all checks the target makes against the user until the end of the next round.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the range of the Basic power and Shared Initiative by 1 range band. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to each check affected by Empowered Initiative. Additionally, the user may spend [FP][FP] to increase the number of dice added by A Step Ahead and On The Back Foot by one, and may do so multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to extend the effects of Insight for an additional round. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to affect an additional ally with Shared Initiative or character with the Basic power. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Shared Initiative
ForceAbility.Description: When using Insight while making an initiative check, an ally within range adds the same symbols to checks they make during the first round of the encounter.

ForceAbility.Name: Seize the Moment
ForceAbility.Description: When performing an Insight power check as part of an initiative check, if no [DA] were spent, each ally adds [SU] to their initiative check. If [DA] was used, the user may take an action before the encounter begins, but each foe adds [SU] to their initiative check.

ForceAbility.Name: Insight Basic Power (Respec)
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend a [FP] to gain hints about what an individual within short range is likely to do in the near future. In structured gameplay, this knowledge does not typically extend beyond the end of the current encounter.

ForceAbility.Name: Empowered Initiative
ForceAbility.Description: When making a check to determine initiative, the user may make an Insight Power check as a part of the pool. Spend [FP] to add [SU] and/or [AD] to all checks the user makes during the first round of the encounter, but only one of each symbol.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: Once per round when activating Strength, the user may increase the maximum silhouette by the user’s Force rating instead. Additionally, the user may spend [FP][FP] to add [SU][AD] to a combined Survival Force power check.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session, the user may spend a Destiny point to use Commune as an out of turn incidental. If they do so, they may not activate Commune until their next turn.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the silhouette of creatures that can be commanded by 1. Additionally, the user may target a creature minion group with a silhouette one less than the maximum silhouette they could affect.

ForceAbility.Name: Range
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to increase the maximum range of the power by one range band. The user may activate this multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Range (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When activating the Range upgrade, increase the maximum range of the power by 2 range bands instead of 1. Additionally, when communing with nature, the specificity and complexity of information gained increases with range, per GM discretion.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: [B]With Creatures:[b] Once per turn when activating Magnitude, the user may affect a number of additional creatures equal to the user’s Force rating instead. [P][B]With Nature:[b] Once per turn when activating Magnitude, the user may gain additional senses or ask additional questions equal to the user’s Force rating instead.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session, the user may spend [FP][FP][FP] to have a creature with silhouette no greater than the user’s Force rating, or a minion group of creatures with a silhouette not greater than half the user's Force rating, rounded up, appear in the scene. If no [DA] was spent to generate [FP], the creature is friendly to the user. If [DA] was spent to generate [FP], the creature is neutral, and attacks a character of the GM’s choosing.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: After successfully activating the Basic power, the user may commit [FO][FO] to maintain their connection to nature, or a creature while it remains in range. While committing, they may gain new or update known information as an incidental once during each future turn. [P]Additionally, if the user successfully activated the Command Creature upgrade, the user may issue a command by performing a maneuver, which they will abide by immediately by performing a maneuver and taking an action.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: [B]With Creatures:[b] The user may spend [FP][FP] to affect an additional creature within range when communing or commanding. [P][B]With Nature:[b] The user may spend [FO] or to gain additional information when communing from nature, or ask an additional question.

ForceAbility.Name: Command Creature
ForceAbility.Description: Make an [B]opposed Survival vs. Discipline check[b] targeting a silhouette 0 creature within range as a part of the Commune power check. On success, may change the creature’s disposition towards the user one step, either from hostile to neutral or from neutral to friendly, and may spend [TR] to change the creature’s disposition from hostile to friendly. If the creature becomes friendly this way, the user may give them a simple command they will immediately abide to the best of their ability, performing a maneuver and taking an action.

ForceAbility.Name: Enhanced Survival
ForceAbility.Description: When making a Survival check, the user may roll an Commune combined power check as part of the dice pool, and may spend [FP] to gain [SU] or [AD] on the check, but only one of each symbol.

ForceAbility.Name: Commune Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: The user can reach out with their feelings to connect with the animals and plants that surround them. [P][B]With Creatures:[b] The user may spend [FP] to learn the emotional state and disposition of one non-sentient creature within short range. Disposition ranges from friendly, to neutral, to hostile. Emotional state runs the gamut of possible sentient experience, in a simpler form. [P][B]With Nature:[b] The user may spend [FP] to gain sensory information or general insight from nature within short range. The GM delivers a brief sense or single feeling that the natural world wishes to impart.

ForceAbility.Name: Natural Attunement
ForceAbility.Description: When activating the Basic power, the user may freely converse with an animal within range, or ask the natural world within range a single, simple question.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to add [SU] to the next check they make that is relevant to their sensed experience. What is relevant is per GM discretion, but could be investigatory or interrogatory in nature.

ForceAbility.Name: Strength (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: When activating Strength, the user also adds [AD] to the affected check.

ForceAbility.Name: Mastery
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session, the user may spend [FP][FP] to gain ranks in one skill possessed by a sensed character or the previous wielder of an engaged item until the end of the encounter. If the user possesses equal or higher skill ranks than the sensed character, increase their ranks in that skill by 1 instead. This chosen skill must be relevant to the event or person sensed, the object held, or the situation at hand, per GM discretion. Alternatively, the user may spend [FP][FP][FP] to temporarily gain access to a Force Power of the sensed character instead, including all non-Mastery upgrades sensed the character had, until the end of the encounter.

ForceAbility.Name: Speed
ForceAbility.Description: Once per session, the user may spend a Destiny Point to use the Psychometry power as an out-of-turn incidental.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FO] to sense an additional experience from a character, object, or scene, and may do so multiple times.

ForceAbility.Name: Magnitude (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: Once per check when the user activates the Magnitude upgrade, the user senses additional images, sounds, or emotions equal to the user's Force rating instead.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration
ForceAbility.Description: Commit [FO][FO] to maintain the effects of Psychometry.

ForceAbility.Name: Duration (Improved)
ForceAbility.Description: Once per round while committing to Duration, the user may spend 2 strain to sense another image, sound, or emotion as an incidental, or increase the clarity of a previously sensed image, sound, or emotion.

ForceAbility.Name: Detection
ForceAbility.Description: The user may always determine if a sensed character is force-sensitive when using Psychometry. They also may sense if any character uses the Dark Side of the Force.

ForceAbility.Name: Clarity
ForceAbility.Description: Spend [FP] to increase the clarity of a sensed image, sound, or emotion. This may be activated multiple times, increasing the clarity of a different sensed experience each time.

ForceAbility.Name: Beyond the Veil
ForceAbility.Description: The user may make a Perception check combined with a Psychometry Force power check. On success, the user senses the last moments of an engaged corpse or remains. The user suffers 1 conflict. The difficulty of the check is determined by the GM, based on the age of the remains.

ForceAbility.Name: Trail of Memories
ForceAbility.Description: The user may spend [FP] to learn the direction of a sensed character if they left the immediate area. This may be activated multiple times, choosing a different sensed character each time. The Duration upgrade cannot be used to increase the duration of this effect.

ForceAbility.Name: Psychometry Basic Power
ForceAbility.Description: Reaching out with their feelings, Force users may sense images, sounds, or emotions of people and events of the past. [P][B]Special Rule ([LI]/[DA] use):[b] When experiencing emotions, only [FP] generated from [DA] may be used to experience negative emotions such as rage or fear. Only [FP] generated from [LI] may be used to experience positive emotions such as selflessness or joy. Both can be used to experience other emotions such as confusion. [P]The user may spend [FP] to sense a distorted and brief image, sounds, or emotion from a previous event or person that happened in the immediate area or involved an engaged object. The event or person, and the age of the experience, is per GM discretion.
